theme.name: Documentary Relief
theme.description: The current default. Graded relief, glowing location dots, and the approved documentary framing.

camera.notes: Compiled from feature bounds; not LLM zoom guesses.

persistence.highlights: Primary highlights persist until superseded; parent_context=subdued demotes parent fill.
persistence.labels: Labels visible for their shot window with short fades.
persistence.camera: zoom_to_boundary interpolates across the shot; hold freezes framing.
persistence.callout: Appears at reveal and holds through duration.

limitations: Terrain is Natural Earth II 50m shaded relief, not live satellite imagery.
The South Asia relief raster covers 45–115E, 0–50N, including India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan. City close-ups enlarge that raster; they do not add local detail.
A country outside that raster drops the regional layer and caps zoom instead of switching to unrelated imagery.
Boundaries and points come from the local catalogue. DeepSeek does not receive polygons.
Point places use a marker and a regional camera extent. No city polygon is invented.
